run_exit_scenario: run a gRPC exit scenario test by passing a scenario name like running_server via CLI
test_generic_handler: test the GenericHandler class that routes RPC methods to the correct hanging servicer handler
test_method_handler: test the MethodHandler class to configure unary or streaming RPC handlers with partial hang support
test_daemon_pool: test the DaemonPool executor that submits daemon threads so gRPC server exits without waiting
test_inflight_call_scenarios: test in-flight unary unary unary stream stream unary or stream stream call exit scenarios
